A live 1-D Gaussian-process surrogate pl.zh:
一个实时的 一维高斯过程代理模型加上一个采集
          函数，共同决定接下来在何处评估一个隐藏的昂贵
          函数。点击以采集，观察置信带收窄，并在收敛图上
          让四种采集策略同场竞速。
A live 1-D Gaussian-process surrogate pl.src:
A live 1-D Gaussian-process surrogate plus an acquisition
          function decides where to evaluate a hidden expensive
          function next. Click to acquire, watch the band shrink, and
          race four acquisition strategies on a convergence plot.

@@T0@@~20 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Pro.zh:
@@T0@@约 20 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@概率 · 优化 · 实验设计@@T3@@

Tuning hyperparameters of a model that t.zh:
为一个需要 8 小时训练的模型调超参数。在湿实验室
          实验中选取下一个浓度。决定下一个空气质量
          传感器部署在何处。你正在优化的函数 $f$ 是昂贵的、
          黑箱的，而且可能带噪声。随机搜索会消耗大量
          调用；网格搜索消耗更多。你希望每一次
          评估都能@@T0@@告诉你最多信息@@T1@@。
Tuning hyperparameters of a model that t.src: Tuning hyperparameters of a model that takes 8 hours to train. Picking the next concentration in a wet-lab experiment. Choosing where to deploy the next air-quality sensor. The function $f$ you're optimising is expensive, black-box, and possibly noisy. Random search burns a lot of calls; grid search burns even more. You want every evaluation to tell you the most.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Fit a.zh:
@@T0@@一句口号。@@T1@@
          用一个廉价的代理模型拟合你的观测；用它
          @@T2@@带不确定性@@T3@@地进行预测；在预测改进量
          最大之处查询下一个点。如此重复。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Fit a.src: The slogan. Fit a cheap surrogate to your observations; use it to predict with uncertainty; query the next point where the predicted-improvement is largest. Repeat.

@@T0@@Surrogate.@@T1@@ A Gaussian proces.zh:
@@T0@@代理模型。@@T1@@ 高斯过程在
            每个点 $x$ 处给出后验均值 $\mu(x)$ 与标准
            差 $\sigma(x)$。在 $\sigma$ 大之处，我们
            尚不了解 $f$。在 $\sigma$ 小之处，代理模型
            较为自信。这与
            @@T2@@
            贝叶斯后验游乐场中的贝叶斯线性回归@@T3@@是同样的后验叙事，
            只是用 RBF 核取代了显式的
            特征基。
@@T0@@Surrogate.@@T1@@ A Gaussian proces.src: Surrogate. A Gaussian process gives, at every point $x$, a posterior mean $\mu(x)$ and standard deviation $\sigma(x)$. Where $\sigma$ is large, we don't yet know $f$. Where $\sigma$ is small, the surrogate is confident. This is the same posterior story as the Bayesian linear regression in the Bayes posterior playground, with an RBF kernel instead of an explicit feature basis.

@@T0@@Acquisition function.@@T1@@ A scal.zh:
@@T0@@采集函数。@@T1@@ 一个建立在
            $(\mu, \sigma)$ 之上的标量得分 $a(x)$，它说明「接下来
            评估这个 $x$ 有多值得？」。不同的采集
            函数在探索与利用之间有着不同的权衡。
@@T0@@Acquisition function.@@T1@@ A scal.src: Acquisition function. A scalar score $a(x)$ on top of $(\mu, \sigma)$ that says "how worth evaluating is this $x$ next?". Different acquisition functions trade exploration vs exploitation differently.

Where $\\Phi$ and $\\phi$ are the standa.zh:
其中 $\Phi$ 与 $\phi$ 分别是标准正态分布的累积分布函数与概率密度函数，
          对当前最优的 $f^*$，$z = (\mu(x) - f^* - \xi) / \sigma(x)$。
          UCB 取置信上界；PI 取
          出现任何改进的概率；EI 取
          期望改进（通常是默认选择）。
Where $\\Phi$ and $\\phi$ are the standa.src:
Where $\Phi$ and $\phi$ are the standard normal CDF and PDF,
          and $z = (\mu(x) - f^* - \xi) / \sigma(x)$ for the current
          best $f^*$. UCB picks the upper-confidence bound; PI picks
          the probability of any improvement; EI picks the
          expected improvement (often the default).

A hidden function (you'll see the true c.zh:
一个隐藏函数（只有在采集了若干点之后你才会看到真实曲线）。按
          @@T0@@采集下一个@@T1@@ 以在 $\arg\max a(x)$ 处评估
          $f$。高斯过程的均值与 2σ 置信带随之更新；
          下方的采集函数重新塑形；收敛图
          在同一个隐藏函数上为全部四种采集策略记录得分。
A hidden function (you'll see the true c.src: A hidden function (you'll see the true curve only after acquiring points). Press Acquire next to evaluate $f$ at $\arg\max a(x)$. The GP mean and 2σ band update; the acquisition function below reshapes; the convergence plot keeps score across all four acquisition strategies on the same hidden function.

GP surrogate (μ ± 2σ) over hidden f.zh: 隐藏函数 f 上的高斯过程代理（μ ± 2σ）

Best-so-far convergence (4 strategies).zh: 目前最优的收敛（4 种策略）

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@应当留意什么。@@T1@@
          起初，EI 与 UCB 广泛探索（置信带处处都很宽）。
          约 5 次采集之后，它们便聚焦到最优
          邻域。PI 更常陷入停滞（它找到
          近似最优便停止探索）。Thompson 采样是一个
          出奇强大的基线，而且实现起来几乎不费吹灰之力：从后验中
          抽取一个样本并取它的 arg-max。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. Early on, EI and UCB explore widely (the band is fat everywhere). After ~5 acquisitions they zoom into the best neighbourhood. PI gets stuck more often (it finds a near-optimum and stops exploring). Thompson sampling is a surprisingly strong baseline that's almost trivial to implement: draw a sample from the posterior and pick its arg-max.

Why Bayesian optimisation, not grid sear.zh: 为何用贝叶斯优化而非网格搜索
Why Bayesian optimisation, not grid sear.src: Why Bayesian optimisation, not grid search

@@T0@@Sample efficiency.@@T1@@ BO finds.zh:
@@T0@@样本效率。@@T1@@ 对典型的超参数任务，BO 在
            20-50 次评估内即可找到最优解，
            而网格搜索需要 200-1000 次。成本上的
            平衡点大约在单次评估成本 > 30 秒之处。
@@T0@@Sample efficiency.@@T1@@ BO finds.src: Sample efficiency. BO finds the optimum of typical hyperparameter tasks in 20-50 evaluations where grid search needs 200-1000. The breakeven point in cost is around evaluation cost > 30 seconds.

@@T0@@Honest uncertainty.@@T1@@ You get.zh:
@@T0@@诚实的不确定性。@@T1@@ 你不仅得到
            最优解，还得到 $f$ @@T2@@全部@@T3@@ 取值的后验。
            当你想知道「在另一点上改进 5% 是否也可接受？」时，
            这一点很有用。
@@T0@@Honest uncertainty.@@T1@@ You get.src: Honest uncertainty. You get not just the optimum, but a posterior over all values of $f$. Useful when you want to know "would 5% better at another point also be acceptable?".

@@T0@@Constraints come for free.@@T1@@ I.zh:
@@T0@@约束可以顺带处理。@@T1@@ 若
            评估存在某些不可行点的约束，
            你可以用另一个高斯过程来建模约束
            概率，并将采集函数乘以它。
@@T0@@Constraints come for free.@@T1@@ I.src: Constraints come for free. If evaluations have a constraint that some are infeasible, you can use a separate GP to model the constraint probability and multiply the acquisition by it.

@@T0@@Multi-fidelity extensions.@@T1@@ W.zh:
@@T0@@多保真度扩展。@@T1@@ 当你
            既有廉价但带噪的评估，又有昂贵但准确的
            评估时（例如短时训练与完整训练），BO 可以
            自动混合二者。
@@T0@@Multi-fidelity extensions.@@T1@@ W.src: Multi-fidelity extensions. When you have cheap-but-noisy and expensive-but-accurate evaluations (e.g., short vs full training run), BO can mix them automatically.

The traps in real BO.zh: 真实 BO 中的陷阱

@@T0@@Kernel choice matters.@@T1@@ RBF i.zh:
@@T0@@核函数的选择很重要。@@T1@@ RBF 是光滑的；
            Matérn 更粗糙；周期核能刻画循环。选择一个
            与你函数实际结构相符的
            核，否则 BO 会把评估浪费在错误
            核所引入的假象上。
@@T0@@Kernel choice matters.@@T1@@ RBF i.src: Kernel choice matters. RBF is smooth; Matérn is rougher; periodic captures cycles. Pick a kernel that matches your function's actual structure or BO will burn evaluations on artefacts of the wrong kernel.

@@T0@@High dimensions hurt.@@T1@@ Pure G.zh:
@@T0@@高维会造成困难。@@T1@@ 纯高斯过程 BO
            在约 20 维以上便变得不可靠。TuRBO、
            BoTorch 以及基于嵌入的 BO 提高了这一上限，但
            仍然困难。
@@T0@@High dimensions hurt.@@T1@@ Pure G.src: High dimensions hurt. Pure GP-BO becomes unreliable above ~20 dimensions. TuRBO, BoTorch, and embedding-based BO push the ceiling, but it's still hard.

@@T0@@Categorical hyperparameters.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@类别型超参数。@@T1@@ 需要
            一个定义在类别 / 整数维度上的核；SMAC 与
            树结构 Parzen 估计器在这方面比朴素高斯过程
            处理得更好。
@@T0@@Categorical hyperparameters.@@T1@@.src: Categorical hyperparameters. Need a kernel over categorical / integer dimensions; SMAC and tree-structured Parzen estimators handle this better than vanilla GPs.

@@T0@@Noise modelling.@@T1@@ Stochastic.zh:
@@T0@@噪声建模。@@T1@@ 随机目标
            （带随机初始化的训练损失）需要在高斯过程中
            加入噪声项。否则代理模型会过拟合到一个带噪
            点，而 BO 会一路追逐它。
@@T0@@Noise modelling.@@T1@@ Stochastic.src: Noise modelling. Stochastic objectives (training loss with random init) need a noise term in the GP. Otherwise the surrogate over-fits to a noisy point and BO chases it.

@@T0@@Acquisition-function maximisation..zh:
@@T0@@采集函数的最大化。@@T1@@
            在 BO 内部你要最大化 $a(x)$。若 $a$ 非凸
            （通常如此），应使用多起点优化；否则
            你会落入采集函数的一个局部最优。
@@T0@@Acquisition-function maximisation..src: Acquisition-function maximisation. Inside BO you maximise $a(x)$. If $a$ is non-convex (it usually is), use multi-start optimisation; otherwise you'll land in a local optimum of the acquisition.

Where Bayesian optimisation is the right.zh: 贝叶斯优化适得其所的场合
Where Bayesian optimisation is the right.src: Where Bayesian optimisation is the right tool

@@T0@@Hyperparameter tuning of expensive.zh:
@@T0@@昂贵模型的超参数调优。@@T1@@
            任何每套配置训练耗时 > 30 分钟的情形。
            使用 BoTorch / Ax / Optuna 的 TPE。
@@T0@@Hyperparameter tuning of expensive.src: Hyperparameter tuning of expensive models. Anything that takes > 30 minutes to train per config. Use BoTorch / Ax / Optuna's TPE.

@@T0@@Sensor / experiment placement unde.zh:
@@T0@@不确定性下的传感器 / 实验布点。@@T1@@
            在一个场模型上最大化后验方差的
            期望缩减量。
@@T0@@Sensor / experiment placement unde.src: Sensor / experiment placement under uncertainty. Maximise expected reduction in posterior variance over a field model.

@@T0@@Wet-lab / hardware experimental de.zh:
@@T0@@湿实验室 / 硬件实验设计。@@T1@@
            每个实验都是一次实时评估。BO 选择
            下一个浓度 / 温度 / 剂量。
@@T0@@Wet-lab / hardware experimental de.src: Wet-lab / hardware experimental design. Each experiment is a real-time evaluation. BO chooses the next concentration / temperature / dose.

@@T0@@Molecule and materials discovery.@.zh: @@T0@@分子与材料发现。@@T1@@ 在化学 / 晶体的学习潜空间上做 BO。这是 2024 年的前沿—BOLT、ChemBO、AlphaFold-Design 等流程都在一个学习到的代理模型之上使用 BO 循环。
@@T0@@Molecule and materials discovery.@.src: Molecule and materials discovery. BO over a learned latent space of chemistry / crystals. The 2024 frontier — BOLT, ChemBO, AlphaFold-Design pipelines all use a BO loop on top of a learned surrogate.

@@T0@@Active learning on a budget.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@有限预算下的主动学习。@@T1@@ 选取
            下一批最大化期望信息增益的点
            —即名为 BALD 或 BOSS 的 BO 与主动学习混合方法。
@@T0@@Active learning on a budget.@@T1@@.src: Active learning on a budget. Pick the next batch of points that maximises expected information gain — the BO-active-learning hybrid called BALD or BOSS.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n B.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          只要单次评估昂贵到让你三思，贝叶斯优化便是首选。
          它每一步都问一个简单的问题 —「我接下来能尝试的
          最有信息量的选项是什么？」— 并用
          贝叶斯游乐场那篇文章中相同的后验工具来回答它。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n B.src: Final takeaway. Bayesian optimisation is the go-to whenever a single evaluation is expensive enough to make you think twice. It asks a simple question every step — "what's the most informative thing I could try next?" — and answers it using the same posterior machinery from the Bayesian playground article.

The four most-used acquisitions, with th.zh: 四种最常用的采集函数，及其闭式解与权衡：
The four most-used acquisitions, with th.src: The four most-used acquisitions, with their closed forms and trade-offs:

@@T0@@Expected Improvement (EI).@@T1@@ C.zh: @@T0@@期望改进（EI）。@@T1@@ 有闭式解（见上），无超参数，探索较为均衡。当代理模型是高斯过程时为默认选择；在运行早期偏向利用，一旦最优点进入平台期便更具探索性。
@@T0@@Expected Improvement (EI).@@T1@@ C.src: Expected Improvement (EI). Closed-form (above), no hyperparameters, balanced exploration. The default when the surrogate is a GP; greedy-exploit early in the run, more exploratory once the best point has plateaued.

@@T0@@Upper Confidence Bound (UCB).@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@置信上界（UCB）。@@T1@@ $\mu(x) + \beta \sigma(x)$。一个旋钮（$\beta$）控制利用与探索的权衡。可证明其遗憾上界为 $O(\sqrt{T \gamma_T})$（Srinivas 等人，2010）。当你需要确定性、可通过旋钮调节的行为时使用它。
@@T0@@Upper Confidence Bound (UCB).@@T1@.src: Upper Confidence Bound (UCB). $\mu(x) + \beta \sigma(x)$. One knob ($\beta$) controls exploitation vs exploration. Provably has $O(\sqrt{T \gamma_T})$ regret (Srinivas et al., 2010). Use when you want deterministic, knob-tunable behaviour.

@@T0@@Probability of Improvement (PI).@@.zh: @@T0@@改进概率（PI）。@@T1@@ $\Pr(f(x) > f^* + \xi)$。易于计算但贪心；往往探索不足。多半只有历史意义。
@@T0@@Probability of Improvement (PI).@@.src: Probability of Improvement (PI). $\Pr(f(x) > f^* + \xi)$. Easy to compute but greedy; tends to under-explore. Mostly historical interest.

@@T0@@Thompson Sampling.@@T1@@ Draw $f \.zh: @@T0@@Thompson 采样。@@T1@@ 抽取一次 $f \sim p(f|D)$，对它做优化，然后评估。天然可并行（每个并行工作进程各自抽取样本）。在批量 / 异步场景中表现强劲。
@@T0@@Thompson Sampling.@@T1@@ Draw $f \.src: Thompson Sampling. Draw $f \sim p(f|D)$ once, optimise it, evaluate. Naturally parallelisable (each parallel worker draws its own sample). Strong in batched / asynchronous settings.

@@T0@@Knowledge Gradient.@@T1@@ Expected.zh: @@T0@@知识梯度。@@T1@@ 后验的一步前瞻期望价值。代价高昂，但对一步贝叶斯目标是最优的；这是 BoTorch 中的现代前沿。
@@T0@@Knowledge Gradient.@@T1@@ Expected.src: Knowledge Gradient. Expected one-step lookahead value of the posterior. Expensive but optimal for the one-step Bayesian objective; the modern frontier in BoTorch.

Real BO loops rarely evaluate one point.zh: 真实的 BO 循环很少一次只评估一个点—你有 $B$ 个并行工作进程（GPU、实验台、模拟器实例）。批量 BO 每轮选取 $B$ 个点。
Real BO loops rarely evaluate one point.src: Real BO loops rarely evaluate one point at a time — you have $B$ parallel workers (GPUs, lab benches, simulator instances). Batch BO picks $B$ points per round.

@@T0@@q-Expected Improvement (qEI).@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@q-期望改进（qEI）。@@T1@@ 在 $B$ 个点上的联合 EI；闭式解不可行；通过从高斯过程后验抽样、以蒙特卡洛方法计算（Wilson 等人，2018）。这是 BoTorch 中的默认选择。
@@T0@@q-Expected Improvement (qEI).@@T1@.src: q-Expected Improvement (qEI). Joint EI over $B$ points; intractable in closed form; computed by Monte Carlo via sampling from the GP posterior (Wilson et al., 2018). Default in BoTorch.

@@T0@@Hallucinated batches (Kriging Beli.zh: @@T0@@幻觉批量（Kriging Believer）。@@T1@@ 贪心地选取第一个点；假装你观测到了 $\mu(x)$；重新拟合；再选下一个；如此重复。代价低但非最优。
@@T0@@Hallucinated batches (Kriging Beli.src: Hallucinated batches (Kriging Believer). Pick the first point greedily; pretend you observed $\mu(x)$; refit; pick the next; repeat. Cheap but suboptimal.

@@T0@@Thompson sampling.@@T1@@ Each para.zh: @@T0@@Thompson 采样。@@T1@@ 每个并行工作进程抽取自己的样本。可轻易并行化；遗憾上界有理论保证。
@@T0@@Thompson sampling.@@T1@@ Each para.src: Thompson sampling. Each parallel worker draws its own sample. Trivially parallelisable; provably good regret.

@@T0@@Asynchronous BO.@@T1@@ When worker.zh: @@T0@@异步 BO。@@T1@@ 当工作进程在不同时刻返回时，你无法暂停；取而代之的是以在途点为条件（它们的后验均值便是对其未知结果的最佳猜测）。
@@T0@@Asynchronous BO.@@T1@@ When worker.src: Asynchronous BO. When workers return at different times, you can't pause; instead, condition on pending points (their posterior mean is your best guess of their unknown outcome).

@@T0@@Shahriari, Swersky, Wang, Adams, d.zh: @@T0@@Shahriari, Swersky, Wang, Adams, de Freitas (2016)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Taking the Human out of the Loop: A Review of Bayesian Optimization.@@T3@@ 标准综述。
@@T0@@Shahriari, Swersky, Wang, Adams, d.src: Shahriari, Swersky, Wang, Adams, de Freitas (2016) — Taking the Human out of the Loop: A Review of Bayesian Optimization. Standard survey.

@@T0@@Srinivas, Krause, Kakade, Seeger (.zh: @@T0@@Srinivas, Krause, Kakade, Seeger (2010)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Gaussian Process Optimization in the Bandit Setting.@@T3@@ 关于 UCB 遗憾界的那篇论文。
@@T0@@Srinivas, Krause, Kakade, Seeger (.src: Srinivas, Krause, Kakade, Seeger (2010) — Gaussian Process Optimization in the Bandit Setting. The UCB-regret paper.

@@T0@@Eriksson et&nbsp;al. (2019)@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Eriksson 等人 (2019)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@TuRBO: Scalable Global Optimization via Local Bayesian Optimization.@@T3@@ 高维 BO 的置信域技巧。
@@T0@@Eriksson et&nbsp;al. (2019)@@T1@@.src: Eriksson et al. (2019) — TuRBO: Scalable Global Optimization via Local Bayesian Optimization. The high-dimensional-BO trust-region trick.

@@T0@@Garnett (2023)@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@.zh: @@T0@@Garnett (2023)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Bayesian Optimization@@T3@@ 教科书。草稿可在线免费获取；是权威的现代参考。
@@T0@@Garnett (2023)@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@.src: Garnett (2023) — Bayesian Optimization textbook. Free draft online; the definitive modern reference.

@@T0@@BoTorch / Ax@@T1@@ — the standard.zh: @@T0@@BoTorch / Ax@@T1@@ — 标准的现代程序库。Optuna 的 TPE 适用于廉价的类别型搜索。
@@T0@@BoTorch / Ax@@T1@@ — the standard.src: BoTorch / Ax — the standard modern libraries. Optuna's TPE for cheap categorical search.

meta.title: 贝叶斯优化，循序渐进
meta.tagline: 在 10 次评估内优化一个昂贵的黑箱函数 —— 并观察代理模型如何更新
meta.summary: 一个 一维高斯过程代理模型加上一个采集函数（EI / UCB / PI / Thompson）共同寻找一个隐藏昂贵函数的最优解。点击以添加观测，观察高斯过程均值与不确定性带收窄，并理解为何 BO 是超参数调优、传感器布点以及任何每次评估都耗费真实时间的实验的正确工具。
highlights: 实时的一维高斯过程代理，含均值 + 2σ 置信带；点击「采集下一个」，观察它在所选点处收窄。
切换采集函数：EI 与 UCB 与 PI 与 Thompson 采样 —— 看哪一个侧重探索、哪一个侧重利用。
切换隐藏的真实函数（正弦、双阱、锯齿），观察 BO 是成功还是吃力。
收敛图在同一个隐藏函数上追踪四种采集函数各自的目前最优值。
